description: This bar chart, titled “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis,” illustrates the accuracy of three sentiment analysis models—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—when applied to two distinct tweet categories: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet.” The vertical axis represents “Accuracy,” scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The horizontal axis categorizes the data into these two tweet types. For “Emoji Tweets,” the bar for TEXTBLOB (white with diagonal hatching) reaches an accuracy of approximately 0.4, the bar for VADER (light gray with diagonal hatching) is at approximately 0.5, and the bar for ChatGPT (solid green) is at approximately 0.7. For “Overall Tweet,” the bar for TEXTBLOB is at approximately 0.4, the bar for VADER is at approximately 0.5, and the bar for ChatGPT is at approximately 0.7. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each tweet category, with each model represented by a distinct color and pattern as indicated in the legend. The bars are not sorted; they appear in the order of the legend, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard presentation.
